help.title: How Ubuzima Bwiza works
help.lead: Short answers for patients, clinicians, and families. For a medical emergency, call 112 or SAMU 912 first.
help.q1: Is the AI assistant a doctor?
help.a1: No. It offers preliminary guidance and specialist suggestions only. It cannot diagnose, prescribe, or replace emergency care.
help.q2: How do I book and pay?
help.a2: Search for a doctor, choose a date and visit type, then pay with MTN MoMo, Airtel Money, card, or cash at the facility. Amounts are in RWF.
help.a3: English, Kinyarwanda, and French. Use the language control in the header. The AI assistant can reply in the language you write.
help.a4: Patients, doctors, hospitals, and platform administrators each have a dedicated workspace after creating an account or signing in.
help.q5: What should I do in an emergency?
help.a5: Do not wait for an online chat. Call 112 or SAMU 912, or go to the nearest hospital immediately.
help.a6: Health information is handled with role-based access, encrypted connections, and responsible hosting. Only authorised users in your care pathway can view your records.
help.a7: Open Messages or Appointments and tap Talk with doctor. Send a chat first, then start video in the same private room. The doctor joins from their appointments. For emergencies, call 112 or SAMU 912.
